{{Quest infobox | name = Little Workshop of Horrors | map = [[File:Oola's Lab Level 1.jpg|200px]]
[[File:Oola's Lab Level 2.jpg|200px]]
[[File:Oola's Lab Level 3.jpg|200px]] | campaign = Eye of the North | region = Depths of Tyria | type = Secondary | repeatable = y | given by = [[Blimm]] | given at = [[Rata Sum]] | preceded by = [[The Elusive Golemancer]] }} Search for Blimm's staff in [[Oola's Lab]]. Due to a malfunction in the [[golem]]s, Blimm depends on you to retrieve his staff. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Investigate the source of the malfunctioning golems. * Defeat the total protection security regulator golem. * See Blimm for your reward. ===Reward=== * 7,500 [[Experience]] * 1,500 [[Gold]] ==Walkthrough== ===Level One=== In the first level, you must kill [[Xien]] to get the dungeon key. He appears and disappears at several points in the dungeon. Just keep heading towards level two and you'll eventually be allowed to kill him for the key. The boss icons on the map for this level mark the locations of [[Flame Guardian (golem)|Flame Guardians]]. For an easier trip, destroy these boss Golems to disable the [[Fire Dart]] traps along the way. ===Level Two=== To obtain the [[dungeon key]] you must destroy the [[Malfunctioning Enduring Golem]]. In order to destroy the Malfunctioning Enduring Golem, you need to pick up the nearby [[Flux Matrix]] and bring it to the [[Unstable Magical Energy Storage]], then drop it next to the Golem to damage it. This may take 2-3 times until the Malfunctioning Enduring Golem is finally destroyed. ===Level Three=== In the third level, destroying one of the the 2 [[Flame Guardian (golem)|Flame Guardians]] will disable half the [[Fire Dart]] traps around the [[TPS Regulator Golem]]. Destroying both Flame Guardians will disable all the Fire Dart traps within the area. To make destroying the TPS Regulator Golem easier, you can attempt to lure the Flame Guardians and/or the TPS Regulator Golem down the stairs of the Fire Dart trapped area. After destroying the TPS Regulator Golem, [[Oola's Chest]] will appear within the area of the Fire Dart traps, so it is recommended to destroy the Flame Guardians. ===Tips=== *The golems tend to bunch up together since they are [[warrior]]s and [[dervish]]es. Bringing skills that cause [[area of effect]] damage is recommended. *[[Minion master]]s will find that there are few corpses to animate and [[Skelk Corrupter]]s use [[Verata's Aura]]. *[[Condition]]s are prevalent here, especially [[blind]]ness and [[burning]]. Skills to remove conditions are very helpful. *Do not confuse this dungeon with the entry in the [[Hero's Handbook]] - which is also called Oola's Lab. Despite having the same name, the handbook requires you to complete the quest [[The Elusive Golemancer]]. *Insects and golems are both [[hostile]] to each other. You can use this to your advantage. ==NPCs== {{see|Oola's Lab#NPCs}} ===Foes=== ;Bosses *{{a}} 24 (24) [[Xien]] → [[Shadow Prison]] (spawns several times on level 1) ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Blimm :''"Oh! Oh, it's you again. Hmmm. Perhaps you can help me. Yes. You can. You see, I went looking for my '''staff'''; it's in '''Oola's Workshop'''. I'm certain. It's a nice, red staff. But the golems have...they've gone crazy! With Oola gone, no one is maintaining the security golems. It must have...they must have broken down."'' :''"I bet the...the '''total protection security regulator''' golem has a cracked circuit crystal. Yes. The TPS regulator has definitely cracked. Without a strict TPS regulator, the whole system breaks down. That must be it. Now, I can't search for my staff. If you don't help me, I'll burn the place down!"'' {{offer dialog |accept = I pity you. Yes, I will help. |decline = Burn it down. I want my staff back."'' ==Trivia== * The quest name is a reference to the '60s Roger Corman movie [[W:The Little Shop of Horrors|Little Shop of Horrors]]. * The internal dialogue regarding TPS, the red staff, and burning the lab down gets its reference from the movie [[W:Office Space|Office Space]].
